title: "Single simulation subject posterior prediction"
author: "B-TAJ"
output:

  pdf_document: default

This follows the Tutorial simulation, then applies the single-subject
posterior-prediction idea used by `realdata_pred`: the fitted posterior is
kept fixed, the selected subject's observed amyloid/tau data are plugged in,
and the subject's two random effects are estimated.

```{r generate single subject}
res <- simu(varying_coef_code_sim, 
            varying_coef_code,
            n_subjects = 1000,
            sa = 8,
            sy = 0.10,
            outer_iter = 1,
            niter = 2000, nburnin = 1000, #thin = 1, 
            nchains = 1,
            save_res = F)

data_1 <- generate_d1(n_subjects = 2,
                          scenario = 1,
                          K = 8, 
                          Kd = 8,
                          sa = 2.5,
                          step = 0.25,
                          sy = 0.07,
                          start_index = 1,
                          end_index = 250,
                          target_threshold = 1, 
                          mid_point = 1, 
                          a_thresh = 1,
                          C = NULL)
    
simudata <- generate_vc(varying_coef_code_sim, data_1, 
                            scenario = 1, #iter = i,
                            save_data = FALSE, root = NULL)
    
subject_id <- data_1$constants$subject_tau
subject_tau <- simudata$constants$subject_tau
cModelsim <- simudata$cModelsim
    
data_surv <- data.frame(subject_id, cModelsim$y_sparse_tau, cModelsim$tt) |> 
      filter(cModelsim.y_sparse_tau >= 1, subject_id %in% subject_tau) |> #filter(cModelsim.t > 5) |> 
      group_by(subject_id) |>
      slice_min(cModelsim.tt, n=1, with_ties = F) |>
      ungroup()

data_surv$censored <- rbinom(nrow(data_surv),1, prob=0.3)
data_surv$thresh <- 0
data_surv$thresh[which(data_surv$cModelsim.y_sparse_tau >= 1)] <- 1
data_surv$t <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
data_surv$c <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
data_surv$t[data_surv$censored == 1] <- NA
data_surv$c[data_surv$censored == 0] <- Inf
    
    
    n_subjects <- data_1$constants$n_subjects
    alpha_tau_pos <- rep(Inf, n_subjects)
    alpha_tau_pos[which(1:n_subjects %in% data_surv$subject_id)] <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt
    simudata$constants$alpha_tau_pos = alpha_tau_pos[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link]
    
    simudata$constants$n_subjects_surv <- length(data_surv$subject_id)
    simudata$constants$Xsub_surv <- simudata$constants$Xsub_amy[data_surv$subject_id,]
    simudata$constants$tau_surv_link <- data_surv$subject_id
    simudata$constants$c <- data_surv$c
    
    tinit <- rep(NA, length(data_surv$subject_id))
    tinit[data_surv$censored == 1] <- data_surv$cModelsim.tt[data_surv$censored == 1] + 1
    
    simudata$inits$tt <- tinit
    simudata$inits$shape_weib <- 1
    simudata$inits$gamma_weib <- c(log(median(data_surv$cModelsim.tt, na.rm = TRUE)), rep(0, 2))
    
    simudata$inits$gamma_amy <- c(50, 0, 0)
    simudata$inits$gamma_tau <- c(55, 0, 0)
    
    # Need to truncate to respect the constraints of the integral
    simudata$inits$alpha[2, data_surv$subject_id] <- pmin(
      data_surv$cModelsim.tt - 1, 
      simudata$inits$alpha[2, data_surv$subject_id]
    )

    # Initialize tau to be same dimension as amyloid 
    
    simudata$data$censored <- data_surv$censored
    simudata$data$tt <- data_surv$t

    max_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata$constants$n_subjects_amy)
    min_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata$constants$n_subjects_amy)
    
    max_t_tau[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- simudata$constants$max_t_tau
    min_t_tau[simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- simudata$constants$min_t_tau
    
    max_t_tau[-simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 0
    min_t_tau[-simudata$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 120
    
    simudata$constants$max_t_tau <- max_t_tau
    simudata$constants$min_t_tau <- min_t_tau
    
    simudata$data$constraint_alpha_tau <- simudata$data$constraint_alpha_amy
# Format data
#simudata_pred <- list(constants = constants, data = data, inits = inits)
simudata_pred <- simudata
samples <- res$res$samples
f_pred_amy <- (samples[,grep("f_pred_amy", colnames(samples))]) 
f_pred_tau <- (samples[,grep("f_pred_tau", colnames(samples))]) 

gamma_amy <- samples[, grepl("^gamma_amy(\\[|$|_)", colnames(samples)), drop = FALSE]
gamma_tau <- (samples[, grepl("^gamma_tau(\\[|$|_)", colnames(samples)), drop = FALSE]) 

sigma_a_amy <- (samples[, grepl("sigma_a_amy", colnames(samples)), drop = FALSE])
sigma_a_tau <- (samples[, grepl("sigma_a_tau", colnames(samples)), drop = FALSE])

sigma_y_amy <- (samples[, grepl("sigma_y_amy", colnames(samples)), drop = FALSE])
sigma_y_tau <- (samples[, grepl("sigma_y_tau", colnames(samples)), drop = FALSE])

rho <- (samples[, grepl("rho", colnames(samples)), drop = FALSE])

simudata_cv <- simudata
simudata_cv$data <- c(
  simudata_cv$data,
  list(
    f_pred_amy = (f_pred_amy),
    f_pred_tau = (f_pred_tau),
    
    gamma_amy = (gamma_amy),
    gamma_tau = (gamma_tau),
    
    sigma_a_amy = c(sigma_a_amy),
    sigma_a_tau = c(sigma_a_tau),
    
    sigma_y_amy = c(sigma_y_amy),
    sigma_y_tau = c(sigma_y_tau),
    rho = c(rho)
  )
)

# Constants
simudata_cv$constants$n_mcmc <- length(rho)
simudata_cv$constants$n_post <- simudata_pred$constants$n_subjects_amy
simudata_cv$constants$N_amy  <- simudata_pred$constants$N_amy
simudata_cv$constants$N_tau  <- simudata_pred$constants$N_tau

# Data
simudata_cv$data$y_pred_amy <- simudata_pred$data$y_pred_amy 
simudata_cv$data$y_pred_tau <- simudata_pred$data$y_pred_tau

simudata_cv$data$t_amy <- simudata_pred$data$t_amy
simudata_cv$data$t_tau <- simudata_pred$data$t_tau

simudata_cv$constants$Xsub_amy  <- simudata_pred$constants$Xsub_amy 

# Constraint
simudata_cv$constants$subject_amy  <- simudata_pred$constants$subject_amy 
simudata_cv$constants$subject_tau  <- simudata_pred$constants$subject_tau
simudata_cv$constants$tau_amy_link <- simudata_pred$constants$tau_amy_link
simudata_cv$data$constraint_alpha_amy <- rep(1, simudata_pred$constants$n_subjects_amy)
simudata_cv$data$constraint_alpha_tau <- rep(1, simudata_pred$constants$n_subjects_amy)

# Subject-specific boundaries for the dconstraint loops
simudata_cv$constants$max_t_amy <- simudata_pred$constants$max_t_amy
simudata_cv$constants$min_t_amy <- simudata_pred$constants$min_t_amy

max_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata_pred$constants$n_subjects_amy)
min_t_tau <- rep(NA, simudata_pred$constants$n_subjects_amy)

tau_subjects <- sort(unique(simudata_pred$constants$tau_amy_link))
tau_positions <- match(
  tau_subjects,
  sort(unique(simudata_pred$constants$subject_tau))
)
max_t_tau[tau_subjects] <- simudata_pred$constants$max_t_tau[tau_positions]
min_t_tau[tau_subjects] <- simudata_pred$constants$min_t_tau[tau_positions]

max_t_tau[-simudata_pred$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 0
min_t_tau[-simudata_pred$constants$tau_amy_link] <- 140

simudata_cv$constants$max_t_tau <- max_t_tau
simudata_cv$constants$min_t_tau <- min_t_tau

# inits
simudata_cv$inits$gamma_amy <- NULL
simudata_cv$inits$gamma_tau <- NULL
simudata_cv$inits$alpha <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2, ncol = simudata_pred$constants$n_subjects_amy)
simudata_cv$inits$alpha[1, ] <- simudata_pred$inits$alpha[1,]
simudata_cv$inits$alpha[2, ] <- simudata_pred$inits$alpha[2,]
```

```{r fit}
source('posterior code/real data mcmc_posterior.R')

posterior_res_forward <- mcchains(posterior_predictions_code,
                                  simudata_cv,
                                  monitors = c("alpha", "gamma_amy_post", "gamma_tau_post",
                                               "f_pred_amy_post", "f_pred_tau_post",
                                               "rho_post"),
                                  niter = 2000,
                                  nburnin = 1000,
                                  thin = 1,
                                  nchains = 1,
                                  fullres = TRUE)
```

```{r threshold-prediction}
post_samples <- posterior_res_forward$samples
alpha_draws <- post_samples[, grep("^alpha\\[", colnames(post_samples)), drop = FALSE]
alpha_amy <- alpha_draws[, seq(1, ncol(alpha_draws), by = 2), drop = FALSE]
alpha_tau_all <- alpha_draws[, seq(2, ncol(alpha_draws), by = 2), drop = FALSE]
tau_subjects <- sort(unique(simudata_cv$constants$tau_amy_link))
alpha_tau <- alpha_tau_all[, tau_subjects, drop = FALSE]

f_amy_post <- post_samples[, grep("^f_pred_amy_post\\[", colnames(post_samples)),
                           drop = FALSE]
f_tau_post <- post_samples[, grep("^f_pred_tau_post\\[", colnames(post_samples)),
                           drop = FALSE]

offset_grid <- (seq_len(ncol(f_amy_post)) -
                  simudata_cv$constants$middle_index) *
  simudata_cv$constants$step

crossing_offset <- function(trajectory, threshold, offsets) {
  hit <- which(trajectory >= threshold)[1]
  if (is.na(hit)) return(NA_real_)
  if (hit == 1L) return(offsets[1])
  stats::approx(trajectory[c(hit - 1L, hit)],
                offsets[c(hit - 1L, hit)],
                xout = threshold, ties = "ordered")$y
}

threshold_age <- function(trajectory_matrix, alpha_vector, threshold, offsets) {
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(trajectory_matrix)), function(i) {
    alpha_vector[i] +
      crossing_offset(trajectory_matrix[i, ], threshold, offsets)
  }, numeric(1))
}

threshold_prediction <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    subject = seq_len(ncol(alpha_amy)),
    biomarker = "Amyloid SUVR",
    posterior_median = vapply(seq_len(ncol(alpha_amy)), function(j) {
      median(threshold_age(f_amy_post, alpha_amy[, j],
                           simudata_cv$constants$amy_thresh, offset_grid),
             na.rm = TRUE)
    }, numeric(1))
  ),
  data.frame(
    subject = tau_subjects,
    biomarker = "Tau PET",
    posterior_median = vapply(seq_len(ncol(alpha_tau)), function(j) {
      median(threshold_age(f_tau_post, alpha_tau[, j],
                           simudata_cv$constants$tau_thresh, offset_grid),
             na.rm = TRUE)
    }, numeric(1))
  )
)

threshold_prediction

post_alpha_amyf <- posterior_res_forward$samples[,grep("alpha", colnames(posterior_res_forward$samples))][, seq(1, simudata_pred$constants$n_subjects_amy*2, by = 2)]

colMedians(post_alpha_amyf)
```
